questions.stem: According to Earhart, how should people think about visiting physical therapists?
options: Only after suffering a serious injury
In the same way they think about visiting dentists, even without a problem
Only when recommended by a doctor
As a last resort after trying other treatments
questions.evidence: Earhart urges people to think about physical therapists just as they do dentists.
questions.explanation_ko: Earhart는 문제가 없어도 치과처럼 정기적으로 물리치료사를 찾아가야 한다고 말했습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, all of the following are areas where physical therapists can help EXCEPT:
options: Preventing falls in aging populations
Helping overweight patients lose weight
Identifying which sports suit a child's body
Diagnosing mental health disorders
questions.evidence: Another area where physical therapists can help is with fall prevention.
questions.explanation_ko: 낙상 예방, 체중 관련 문제, 아이들의 스포츠 적합성은 언급되었지만 정신 건강 진단은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about why some people avoid yearly physical therapy exams?
options: They do not believe physical therapists are qualified
The exams are not usually covered by health insurance, making them costly
Physical therapists are too hard to find in most states
Doctors discourage patients from seeing physical therapists
questions.evidence: However, a yearly exam might not be covered by a person’s health insurance. This could prevent some from seeking out care.
questions.explanation_ko: 보험이 적용되지 않아 비용 부담이 생겨 일부 사람들이 검진을 피할 수 있다는 것을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author include Earhart's comment about children and ballet ('Maybe they don’t have the hips for ballet')?
options: To argue that ballet is a dangerous activity for all children
To give a concrete example of how early screening can match children to suitable activities
To show that physical therapists disapprove of dance training
To compare the cost of ballet lessons to physical therapy sessions
questions.evidence: She added about children, “Maybe they don’t have the hips for ballet.”
questions.explanation_ko: 이 예시는 조기 검진이 아이의 신체에 맞는 활동을 찾는 데 어떻게 도움이 되는지 구체적으로 보여주기 위해 사용되었습니다.

questions.stem: In the sentence "it could save a lot pain and problems down the line," what does the phrase "down the line" mean?
options: Along a specific path or route
In the future
In a different location
During a conversation
questions.evidence: If we screened kids as they were choosing sports and said this sport is probably not the right kind of stress for the way you are put together, it could save a lot pain and problems down the line.

blanks.meaning: 잘 알려지지 않은 비밀 (여기서는 물리치료사의 가치가 덜 알려졌다는 의미)
blanks.sentence_ko: 업계 지도자 중 한 명인 Sharon Dunn은 물리치료사를 '의료계에서 가장 잘 알려지지 않은 비밀'이라고까지 부릅니다.
만약 아이들이 스포츠를 선택할 때 이 운동이 그들의 신체 구조에 맞는 스트레스가 아니라고 검진을 통해 알려준다면, 나중에 많은 고통과 문제를 줄일 수 있을 것입니다.
하지만 두 전문가 모두 그러한 검진이 장기적으로 비용을 절약하고 건강한 수명을 늘릴 수 있다고 말했습니다.
물리치료사들은 그러한 조기 검진을 실시할 수 있습니다.

key_points: Physical therapists can help prevent health problems, not just treat injuries after they occur.
Experts recommend yearly wellness visits similar to regular dental checkups.
Physical therapy exams can identify posture problems, unsuitable sports for children, and injury risks in runners.
Physical therapy can help with fall prevention in older adults by building confidence and strength.
Physical therapists also assist overweight patients in losing weight to reduce joint stress.
Cost and lack of insurance coverage can be barriers to receiving preventive physical therapy.
main_idea: Physical therapists can play a valuable preventive role in health care by identifying and addressing potential problems—such as poor posture, unsuitable physical activities, fall risk, and weight-related joint stress—before they become serious issues.
restate_sentence: If we screened kids as they were choosing sports and said this sport is probably not the right kind of stress for the way you are put together, it could save a lot pain and problems down the line.
